integrations.title: Git Webhooks
integrations.subtitle: Connect your repositories to automatically complete Quests when Pull Requests are merged.
integrations.inst1: Go to Settings > Webhooks in Github or Bitbucket.
integrations.inst2: Paste the Webhook URL. Select Content type: application/json.
integrations.inst3: Paste the Secret Token. Select only Pull Request events.
integrations.inst4: Add [SPAR-12345678] to your PR title. When merged, the Quest will auto-complete.
